scope: Prospective independent new queries on the same five resident graphs; no unseen-graph generalization claim.
generator_distribution: unchanged historical grammar, endpoint-label probabilities and Gaussian vector perturbation; no answer-aware rejection
timing_design: Even-order Williams design: each arm occupies each ordinal position once per query; random arm relabeling and row order. One untimed same-arm/same-query warmup immediately before every timed request.
state: Every session allocates fresh mutable predicate/certificate state; graph, HNSW index, model, code and hardware caches resident/warm.
timing_scope: In-process request wall time from invocation before feature extraction through returned native result; includes feature extraction/catalog lookup, routing/dispatch, bindings, native execution and output conversion; excludes network, input generation, immutable index loading/construction, model loading and quality audits.
baseline_cost: Eager and RACE directly execute the submitted query; no unnecessary routing features are charged to fixed arms.

training.split: all historical balanced cases; no final query labels

frozen_headroom_decision.basis: Historical OOF execution savings are nonpositive for all three learned selectors; measured historical Python wrapper costs also exceed mean empirical-oracle headroom. Therefore no learned candidate passes savings > inference-cost screening. Native inference alone does not repair a wrong choice.

primary_estimands: ratio of summed per-query median full-path runtime for each of seven non-Eager arms versus Eager
realized excess cost of the frozen audit choice Eager relative to each of seven non-Eager arms; best-arm summary is post-selection and accompanied by simultaneous bounds
secondary_estimands: mean/median/p95/p99/max query regret against the two-fixed-policy empirical oracle
answer equality and exact-reference recall including empty-answer convention

inference.cluster: corpus:new-seed, 50 blocks total; ten blocks in each of five fixed strata
inference.resampling: within each fixed corpus resample ten whole seed blocks, same indices for all arms; conditional frozen models
inference.paired_tests: seven two-sided seed-block sign flips versus Eager (including RACE); 100000 fixed-seed Monte Carlo sign patterns, plus-one correction; Holm family of seven comparisons

audit_decision_validation.criterion: Report all continuous differences regardless of significance. Label audit choice noninferior within 1% only if the upper one-sided simultaneous bootstrap bound for Eager/candidate is at most 1.01 for every one of the seven non-Eager arms. Bonferroni tail .05/7. This margin is defined prospectively here, not claimed universal. Failure is inconclusive or contrary evidence, never recoded as validation.

quality: All eight arm outputs must equal Eager per repeat; all returned nodes checked for predicate legality and exact-reference recall computed after timing. Empty exact set scores one only when returned set is also empty. No cases excluded for emptiness, latency or router loss.
failure_policy: Abort on corruption/mismatched outputs; preserve all partial logs and report cause. A technical retry requires a named iteration and unchanged model/query plan; do not tune based on observed outcomes.
pilot: Only seed -1 (separate stream) may be used for correctness smoke tests before the final timing window; never final seeds100-109.
execution: CPU 6, one thread, final timing serialized with other project benchmarks under root scheduling.
